name: cphast
central_question: If the physical parts are reusable but the deployed composition changes, what should the model keep fixed, what should it rebuild, and what should it expose to decision layers?

audience.primary: ML, robotics, power-systems, and scientific-modeling readers
needs: domain-native wording for robotics, FHN, and microgrid examples
recall hooks before dense equations, tables, and figures
clear separation between reusable local physics, deployed interconnection, observations, and downstream action-card scoring

domain_terms.typed: named physical variable, block, port, or consequence channel with declared meaning
domain_terms.chart: coordinate or normalization map from raw observations into model-facing local coordinates
domain_terms.port: power-carrying interface between stored energy and outside influence
domain_terms.PHASTCore: the reusable local port-Hamiltonian update block
domain_terms.action card: downstream objective-conditioned use of typed rollout factors, not the world-model output itself

topic_checks.name: Canonicalization / Local pH State Bridge Check
topic_checks.answered_question: Why do charted observations need a local pH state before PHASTCore?

topic_checks.name: Typed Consequence / Action-Card Bridge Check
topic_checks.answered_question: How do model-facing typed consequences become downstream decision-facing factors?
